answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can vote; each account must also earn a scarce, time-limited proof-of-work ticket, so splitting into Sybils multiplies both locked capital and compute. A detector that finds coordinated duplicates burns the bond. Naming each cohort “saffron,” “island,” or “reef” changes nothing: an attacker pays the same per identity, making fake reach costly rather than free.
